title: Heat kernel for reflected jump diffusion on Ahlfors regular domains
summary: We study reflected jump diffusions on Ahlfors regular domains in general metric measure spaces. Under the condition that the Dirichlet form on the ambient space satisfies a capacity upper bound estimate, we construct an extension operator from the reflected Dirichlet space to the ambient Dirichlet space, with a scale-invariant local bound. Second, we establish the mixed stable-like heat kernel estimates for the reflected jump diffusion, assuming that the process on the ambient space satisfies the same type of heat kernel estimates.
